source_tests.environment: Isolated temporary state, synthetic providers and loopback HTTP servers; no paid API requests.

regressions: Bounded HTTP errors retain structured status and safe diagnostic vocabulary; secret, short/normalized prompt echo, oversized and non-JSON bodies are covered
Shared-context limits use complete wire inputs, retain requested maximum and effort, recompute for reviews, and stop before dispatch when no verified headroom remains
Worker status records effective request settings and structured failures without automatic retries
Explicit 1.3.3 pre-review reapproval archives the old contract, retains successful attempts, and rejects changed attempts/review packets/runtime
Canonical Codex identities are scoped to the original conversation; same-chat reuse remains blocked and session rebinding cannot relabel the identity
Approval displays the rule for external members and external chairmen, including the chairman-only case

independent_review.result: No remaining concrete blockers after fixes
findings_resolved: Short/normalized request reflections and unfiltered structured error strings
independent_review.verification: Thirteen focused tests in initial audit; ten focused tests after fixes; source comparisons confirm unchanged neutral prompts, task/rubric/delivery and anonymous-review modules. HTTP approval regressions were run in the main suite.

skill_validation: Main SKILL frontmatter unchanged from the prior validated release; modified references inspected. Standalone quick_validate helper unavailable because PyYAML is not installed.

task_alignment.description: Answers the whole approved question and satisfies its requested deliverable and constraints.

correctness_evidence.description: Claims are accurate relative to supplied evidence; distinguish established facts, inference and unknowns. Creative work does not need irrelevant citations. Peer agreement is not evidence.

reasoning.description: Conclusions follow from premises; consider consequential alternatives, counterevidence and failure modes without manufacturing doubts.

actionability.description: The answer can be used for the actual task; recommendations are feasible and concrete. For explanatory/creative work, judge usefulness rather than demand an implementation plan.

clarity.description: Clear, precise, appropriately concise and suited to the requested audience and format; length, polish and confidence alone earn no credit.

anchors.0: Absent, unusable, or directly contradicts a central requirement/evidence.
anchors.2: Partly useful, but material gaps or unsupported claims remain.
anchors.3: Adequately meets the criterion with clearly bounded limitations.
anchors.4: Strongly meets the criterion; only minor, specific improvements needed.
anchors.5: Exceptionally well supported and task-complete on this criterion; no material defect found in supplied evidence. This is not a claim of certainty.

harness.scale: integer 0–5; weighted assessment /100, never a probability
harness.review_policy: Each reviewer sees all answers in a frozen independently shuffled order. All complete valid ballots have equal weight, including self-review as upstream. Also report leave-self-out sensitivity. No current-round reviews or author mapping in review packets. Any approved history is shared context, not new evidence or independent votes.
harness.codex_policy: One independent Codex participant; fresh isolated proposer and a different fresh isolated reviewer. Current chairman does not cast a second vote.

limitations: The original real HTTP 400 body was discarded by 1.3.3; its specific server-side cause cannot be reconstructed. Shared-context over-allocation is a supported hypothesis, not a confirmed live root cause.
Live DeepSeek acceptance still requires a newly human-approved retry; tests exercise real adapters with synthetic responses.
Input capacity uses a conservative UTF-8 estimate plus framing, not an exact tokenizer. Error messages intentionally lose arbitrary text and numeric values.
The recovery migration is limited to audited 1.3.3 first rounds at rest before reviews; it is not a general approval transfer.
Host tooling and the user must still provide truthful real agent IDs; the plugin does not independently attest a host process identity.
